title: Deploy staging build and smoke-test the login page
summary: The user pulled the latest main, ran the deploy script, then opened the staging URL in a browser and verified the login page rendered.
goal: Deploy the current build to staging and confirm the login flow works.

steps.observation: The user runs ./deploy.sh staging and output streams to the terminal.
steps.inferred_intent: Deploy the latest build to the staging environment.
steps.agent_hint: Run `./deploy.sh staging` and wait for the 'Deploy complete' line.

action.expected_state: Terminal prints 'Deploy complete' with exit code 0.

steps.observation: The user opens the staging login URL; the login form renders.
steps.inferred_intent: Verify the deploy succeeded by loading the login page.
steps.agent_hint: Navigate to the staging login URL and confirm the email/password form is visible.

action.expected_state: Login form with email and password fields is visible.
